pulse: First night holds: Dan checked everything, Hui Ling is settled, and for a few hours the dead stay quiet.
scene: A sunny day charged the batteries, so the van was warm and lit through the night; Dan checked the ramp one last time, then sat with Hui Ling as the city fell silent below.

day_summaries.1: Day 1 passed quiet: clear skies charged the batteries, the systems held, and they moved through routine (water, filter, meals) without friction. Dan checked the ramp twice; Hui Ling watched the streets below. By nightfall the van was warm and full of power, and they'd survived the first day—the first of many ahead.
